description: This file is a shell script containing a comprehensive test suite for git fetch/push functionalities. It defines various test cases for verifying command-line syntax, refspecs, hooks, configuration options, hook triggers, ref updates, error handling, and edge cases in git operations.

methods.name: mk_empty
methods.description: Initializes an empty git repository with specific configuration and setup.

methods.name: mk_test
methods.description: Creates a new repository, pushes commits to refs, and verifies refs and object integrity.

methods.name: mk_test_with_hooks
methods.description: Sets up a test repository with hook scripts and verifies hook triggers during push.

methods.name: mk_child
methods.description: Clones an existing repository into a new directory.

methods.name: check_push_result
methods.description: Verifies that specific refs in a repository match expected commits.

methods.name: grep_wrote
methods.description: Checks trace output for specific pack write activity.

methods.name: test_force_push_tag
methods.description: Tests force pushing tags (lightweight and annotated).
